Introduction

Huang Xinchun, also known as Hwang Shin Chon and Ryder Huang, is a Chinese idol singer and member of the boy group NEX7 under Yue Hua Entertainment. He made his debut as a member of NEX7 on June 21, 2018 with the album ‘THE FIRST’ and later made his solo debut in 2019.

He also participated in Idol Producer in 2018 but was eliminated, ranking 32nd.
